title: Tebboune's "Except One Gulf Country" Remark Resurfaces After Algeria–UAE Rupture
excerpt: Algerian President Tebboune's October 2025 remark that Algeria is on brotherly terms with all Gulf states except one he would not name is circulating again after Algeria cut ties with the UAE on 10 September 2026.
rank_math_title: Tebboune's "except one Gulf country" remark and the Algeria–UAE rupture | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Tebboune's "except one Gulf country" remark is back in the news. Algeria's break with the UAE and what each side has said.
